concepts.label: A — 金色账本
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: Android launcher icon concept for a minimalist personal expense diary app named 有钱日记. Generate ONE square standalone icon, not a contact sheet. Background fills the entire square canvas edge-to-edge in deep ink forest #282E29, no outer border or mockup. Main symbol centered with generous 22% safe margins so Android circle/squircle masks preserve it. Palette exclusively forest #282E29, warm gold #F3D48A and ivory #F7F5F0. Visually legible at 48px. No lettering, words, numbers, labels, watermarks, currency signs, graphs, extra decorations, devices or presentation context. A distinctive minimal closed diary / ledger book, pale warm gold cover, dark forest spine, one beautifully integrated short ledger line and small circular clasp. Bold simple silhouette, refined flat geometric shapes with just a subtle embossed edge, understated premium stationery feel.
